title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage! — Episode6 Weeding With Everyone

meta.Event Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Line: Volunteer Day
Shrine

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Please come over here and form an orderly line for me, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
It's great how so many little kids decided to join us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
Things feel so lively with so many people from the community gathered together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Quite a few seem to be here for the test of courage since it's not often that they get to do one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's do our best to make sure they enjoy pulling weeds and our test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Has Mizuki not arrived yet...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I just received a message. “I'll get there when the test of courage starts.”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Apparently, no one was available to cover at work, so we won't be seeing Mizuki until later this evening.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: To add, “I'm really sorry, but I promise to make up for it during the test of courage!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Then, the four of us will need to pull as many weeds as we can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make Operation: Exciting Weed Pulling a big success!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize you'd come up with such a wonderful name.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing she just came up with that, but it is definitely Otori's kind of name.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's do this!
Here we...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Honami & Shizuku
rows.Line: Go!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line:
Out you...!
Hnng! It's totally stuck!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is everything okay? Would you like some help?

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: Oh, so... These weeds are so stubborn!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, these?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You should be able to pull them out if you carve a little circle around them with your trowel first.

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line:
A circle...?
Hey, look at that! They came right out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did a wonderful job! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, to celebrate... Let's high five♪

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for helping me, you two!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everyone, please place the weeds you've pulled into your plastic bags and bring them to the collection area over here once they're full.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're in the shade, but it's still pretty hot...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I'm drenched in sweat!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...!
I believe it's time for your hard work to be rewarded!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line: Huh? Rewarded?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here's some nice and cool shaved ice that Asahina and I just made!

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's enough for everyone, so please come and get them one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Operation: Shaved Ice seems to be going very well, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but the line's getting huge...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We gotta keep making more!
Spin! Spin! Spin! Spin!
se_event_horror_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe getting one with a manually operated crank to cut costs wasn't such a good idea...
Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mmm!
It's so much fun to eat as a big group like this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
And having worked so hard to pull those weeds makes this lunch taste even better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. We should be able to recharge our batteries for this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not only that, everyone is...)

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line:
You're all students, right?
Thank you for working so hard to pull weeds with us.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student B
rows.Line:
No, it's our pleasure!
Pulling weeds with all of you has been really fun!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler B
rows.Line: Hey, is the stuff you study in high school really hard?

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Student A
rows.Line:
Yeah, super duper hard.
What sort of stuff are you studying recently?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They all seem to be having a fun time interacting with the locals...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to all have lunch here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm so glad that they're all having fun!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I've gotta keep doing my best until the very end!)

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Keep it up! Just a little bit more to go!

rows.Speaker: Participants
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (We should be finished pulling these weeds in about thirty minutes. I'm glad things are moving right on schedule.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But we need to stay focused throughout the test of courage. We need to make sure nothing goes wrong there...)
Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello.
I know you must be tired, so please take this sports drink if you like.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've been working very hard, so please make sure to take breaks when you can, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, umm... Thank you, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How are you feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This might be none of my business, but... I've been worrying that you might be pushing yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay...
I don't feel all that tired since we have so many people here helping us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But please let me know if anything happens or if you start feeling fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll be right there to help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.
